passages.title: 中秋烤肉引來消防車
passages.text: During the Moon {1}, my whole family has a barbecue in front of our house. This year, Dad wanted to cook everything by himself. But he put too much meat on the grill, and smoke went everywhere. Our neighbor thought there was a fire and called 119! When the firefighters came, Dad was very embarrassed. "Don't {2}," one firefighter said with a smile. "This happens a lot during the festival." Dad decided to {3} the food with the firefighters. In {4}, they were very hungry after a long day. They all ate together and looked at the moon. Next year, Dad says, he will buy food from the night {5} instead.

blanks.why: Moon Festival「中秋節」。Moon Market、Moon Fact、Moon Example 都不是節日名稱。
Don't worry.「別擔心。」park、sell、place 後面都需要受詞，放在這裡不通。
share + 物 + with + 人「和某人分享」：爸爸決定把食物分給消防員。worry、fight、surprise the food 都不通。
in fact「事實上」是固定片語。in festival、in market、in example 都不是片語。
night market「夜市」。night fact、night surprise、night place 都不是正確說法。

passages.zh: 每年中秋節，我們全家都會在家門口烤肉。今年爸爸想自己一個人烤全部的東西，但他在烤架上放了太多肉，煙飄得到處都是。鄰居以為失火了，就打了 119！消防員來的時候，爸爸超尷尬。「別擔心，」一位消防員笑著說，「中秋節常常發生這種事。」爸爸決定把烤肉分給消防員吃。事實上，他們忙了一整天，早就餓壞了。大家一起吃東西、一起賞月。爸爸說，明年他要改去夜市買現成的。

passages.title: 母親節的驚喜早餐
passages.text: Last Mother's Day, my brother and I wanted to give Mom a {1}. We got up at six and went to the kitchen to {2} breakfast. But neither of us knew how to make eggs. My brother dropped three eggs on the floor, and we started to {3}. "It's your fault!" "No, it's yours!" Then Mom walked in. We thought she would be angry. In {4}, she laughed. "Let's do it together," she said. The three of us made pancakes and {5} them at the table. It was not the surprise we planned, but it was the best breakfast ever.

blanks.why: give + 人 + a surprise「給某人驚喜」。a fact、a market、a festival 都不能當成送給媽媽的東西。
cook breakfast「做早餐」。worry、fight、place breakfast 都不通。
start to fight「開始吵架」，後面兩人互相怪罪。place、surprise、sell 後面需要受詞，這裡不通。
in fact「事實上」：我們以為她會生氣，事實上她笑了。in market、in festival、in park 都不通。
share + 物「分享」：一起分著吃鬆餅。fought、worried、parked them 都不通。

passages.zh: 去年母親節，我和哥哥想給媽媽一個驚喜。我們六點就起床，到廚房做早餐。但我們兩個都不會煎蛋。哥哥把三顆蛋掉到地上，我們就開始吵架：「都是你的錯！」「不，是你的錯！」這時媽媽走了進來，我們以為她會生氣，事實上她笑了。「我們一起做吧。」她說。我們三個人做了鬆餅，在餐桌上一起分著吃。雖然這不是我們計畫中的驚喜，卻是最棒的一頓早餐。

passages.title: 市場裡的魚販阿伯
passages.text: Every Saturday, I go to the traditional {1} with my grandma. She knows every seller there. The fish seller, Uncle Lee, always saves the best fish for her. He has worked in the same {2} for forty years. Last week, Uncle Lee was not there. Grandma looked {3}. The woman {4} to his stall told us he was sick. So Grandma decided to {5} some chicken soup for him. The next day, we took the soup to his house. He was so happy. "You are like family to me," he said.

blanks.why: traditional market「傳統市場」，後面說她認識每一個攤販。traditional fact、traditional surprise、traditional worry 都不通。
work in the same place「在同一個地方工作」。the same fact、the same surprise、the same festival 都不通。
look worried「看起來很擔心」，look 後面接形容詞。cooked、shared、fought 都不能形容阿嬤的表情。
next to「在…旁邊」：他攤位旁邊的女士。last to、same to、every to 都不是正確用法。
cook soup「煮湯」：阿嬤決定煮雞湯給他。fight、worry、place soup 都不通。

passages.zh: 每個星期六，我都會跟奶奶去傳統市場。她認識那裡的每一個攤販。賣魚的李伯伯總是把最好的魚留給她，他在同一個地方工作四十年了。上星期，李伯伯沒有出現，奶奶看起來很擔心。他攤位旁邊的阿姨告訴我們，他生病了。於是奶奶決定煮雞湯給他。隔天，我們把湯送到他家，他好開心。「你們就像我的家人一樣。」他說。

passages.title: 拔河比賽前的爭吵
passages.text: During sports day, our class joined the tug-of-war. Before the game, Jason and Leo started to {1} about who should stand at the front. "I am stronger!" said Jason. "No, I am!" said Leo. Our teacher {2} that we would lose. So she said, "A team that fights inside cannot win. The strongest team is not the one with the strongest arms. In {3}, it is the one that works together." Jason and Leo shook hands. We {4} the biggest students at the back and pulled together. We won first {5}!

blanks.why: fight about …「為了…吵架」。cook about、share about、place about 都不通。
worry that + 句子「擔心…」：老師擔心我們會輸。cooked、shared、placed that 都不通。
in fact「事實上」。in market、in festival、in park 都不是片語。
place + 人 + 地方「把…安排在某處」：我們把最壯的同學排在最後面。cooked、shared、stayed 都不能這樣用。
win first place「得到第一名」。first fact、first market、first festival 都不通。

passages.zh: 運動會那天，我們班參加拔河比賽。比賽前，Jason 和 Leo 為了誰要站第一個吵了起來。「我比較壯！」Jason 說。「才不是，是我！」Leo 說。老師擔心我們會輸，於是說：「內部吵架的隊伍不可能贏。最強的隊伍不是手臂最有力的，事實上，是最能團結合作的。」Jason 和 Leo 握了握手。我們把最壯的同學排在最後面，一起用力拉。我們得到了第一名！

passages.title: 外公的八十歲驚喜
passages.text: Grandpa's eightieth birthday was coming. Our family planned a {1} party for him. We were {2} that he would find out. So we told him we were going to a restaurant, but in {3}, we took him to his old elementary school. All his old classmates were there! Grandpa could not believe his eyes. Grandma {4} his favorite dishes, and everyone sat at long tables. His old friends {5} stories about when they were young. One man said, "Your grandpa was the best runner in our school!" Grandpa laughed so hard. "This is the best birthday of my life," he said.

blanks.why: surprise party「驚喜派對」。fact party、market party、place party 都不是正確說法。
be worried that …「擔心…」。were cooked、were shared、were fought 用在人身上都不通。
in fact「事實上」：說要去餐廳，事實上是去他的小學。in market、in festival、in example 都不是片語。
cook dishes「煮菜」：奶奶煮了他最愛的菜。fought、worried、lost his favorite dishes 都不通。
share stories「分享故事」。fought、cooked、worried stories 都不通。

passages.zh: 外公的八十歲生日快到了，我們全家為他計畫了一場驚喜派對。我們很擔心他會發現，所以跟他說要去餐廳，事實上卻帶他回到他以前念的小學。他所有的老同學都在那裡！外公簡直不敢相信自己的眼睛。外婆煮了他最愛吃的菜，大家坐在長長的桌子旁。老朋友們分享著年輕時的故事。有一位爺爺說：「你外公以前是我們學校跑最快的！」外公笑得好開心。「這是我這輩子最棒的生日。」他說。

passages.title: 元宵節的兔子燈籠
passages.text: At the Lantern {1}, my little sister got a rabbit lantern. She held it all night and would not {2} it with me. Then a strong wind came, and the lantern flew out of her hands. It landed in a tree. She started to cry. "Don't {3}. We can get it back," Mom told her. A tall man {4} to us came to help. He used a long stick and got the lantern down. In {5}, it was not broken at all. My sister was so happy that she let me hold it for the rest of the night.

blanks.why: Lantern Festival「元宵節」。Lantern Market、Lantern Fact、Lantern Surprise 都不是節日名稱。
share + 物 + with + 人「和某人分享」：她不肯跟我分享燈籠。cook、fight、worry it with me 都不通。
Don't worry.「別擔心」，後面說「我們可以拿回來」。cook、place、share 放在這裡意思都不通。
next to「在…旁邊」：我們旁邊的一位高個子男士。last to、same to、every to 都不是正確用法。
in fact「事實上」：燈籠事實上一點都沒壞。in festival、in market、in example 都不是片語。

passages.zh: 元宵節那天，妹妹拿到一個兔子燈籠。她整晚都緊緊拿著，不肯分我玩。後來一陣強風吹來，燈籠從她手中飛走，掉到一棵樹上。她哭了起來。「別擔心，我們可以拿回來。」媽媽對她說。我們旁邊一位高個子叔叔過來幫忙，他用一根長棍子把燈籠弄了下來。事實上，燈籠一點都沒壞。妹妹開心極了，剩下的晚上都讓我拿著它。

passages.title: 吵了十年的鄰居
passages.text: Mr. Wu and Mr. Ho live {1} to each other. For years, they {2} about everything: the trees, the noise, and the parking space. One day, Mr. Ho fell in his garden and could not stand up. Mr. Wu heard him and ran over. He called an ambulance and waited with him. It was a big {3} to Mr. Ho. A week later, Mr. Ho came home from the hospital. He {4} a big dinner and invited Mr. Wu. They talked and laughed for hours. Now they {5} the parking space, and they even go fishing together.

blanks.why: live next to each other「住在隔壁」。last to、same to、every to 都不是正確用法。
fight about …「為了…爭吵」，過去式 fought。cooked about、shared about、surprised about 都不通。
a big surprise to + 人「讓某人很驚訝的事」：吳先生來救他，讓何先生很驚訝。a big fact、festival、market 都不通。
cook dinner「煮晚餐」：他煮了一頓大餐請吳先生。fought、worried、hurt a big dinner 都不通。
share the parking space「共用停車位」。fight、worry、cook the parking space 都不通。

passages.zh: 吳先生和何先生住在隔壁。好多年來，他們什麼都吵：樹、噪音，還有停車位。有一天，何先生在花園裡跌倒，站不起來。吳先生聽到了，馬上跑過去，幫他叫了救護車，還陪他一起等。這讓何先生非常驚訝。一個星期後，何先生出院回家，他煮了一頓大餐邀請吳先生。他們聊天、大笑了好幾個小時。現在他們一起共用停車位，甚至還會一起去釣魚。

passages.title: 校園跳蚤市場
passages.text: Our school held a flea {1} last weekend. Students brought things they did not need and {2} them to others. I sold my old comic books. My friend Ken's dad {3} a big pot of fried rice, and Ken sold it at his table. It was the most popular food there. In {4}, it was gone in twenty minutes. At the end of the day, Ken and I were very hungry, but there was only one box left. So we {5} it. It was the best fried rice I have ever eaten.

blanks.why: flea market「跳蚤市場」是固定說法。flea festival、flea fact、flea surprise 都不是。
sell + 物 + to + 人「賣給某人」，過去式 sold。cooked、worried、fought them to others 都不通。
cook fried rice「炒飯、煮炒飯」。fought、worried、surprised a pot of fried rice 都不通。
in fact「事實上」：事實上二十分鐘就賣光了。in festival、in market、in example 都不是片語。
share + 物「分著吃」：只剩一盒，我們就分著吃。fought、worried、parked it 都不通。

passages.zh: 上週末，我們學校舉辦了跳蚤市場。學生把不需要的東西帶來賣給別人。我賣掉了舊漫畫。我朋友 Ken 的爸爸炒了一大鍋炒飯，讓 Ken 在他的攤位上賣，那是現場最受歡迎的食物。事實上，二十分鐘就賣光了。一天結束時，Ken 和我都餓壞了，但只剩下一盒，所以我們就分著吃。那是我吃過最好吃的炒飯。

passages.title: 愛擔心的小熊
passages.text: Benny the bear {1} about everything. When it rains, he thinks the river will flood. When it is sunny, he thinks the forest will catch fire. One day, his friend Rabbit said, "Let's go to the forest {2} tonight! There will be music and dancing." Benny said no. "There will be too many animals. What if someone steps on my foot?" But Rabbit did not give up. She {3} his favorite honey cake and said, "Come, just for one hour." At the festival, Benny danced and sang. He even {4} his honey cake with a little fox. Nobody stepped on his foot. In {5}, he had the best night of his life. "Most of my worries never happen," he said.

blanks.why: worry about …「擔心…」，主詞第三人稱單數用 worries。cooks、shares、places about 都不通。
forest festival「森林慶典」，後面說有音樂和跳舞。forest fact、forest surprise、forest worry 都不通。
cook + 食物「做（菜、點心）」：兔子做了他最愛的蜂蜜蛋糕。worried、fought、placed a cake 都不通。
share + 物 + with + 人「和…分享」。worried、fought、placed his cake with a fox 都不通。
in fact「事實上」。in festival、in market、in example 都不是片語。

passages.zh: 小熊 Benny 什麼都擔心。下雨的時候，他擔心河水會氾濫；出太陽的時候，他擔心森林會著火。有一天，他的朋友兔子說：「我們今晚去參加森林慶典吧！會有音樂和跳舞喔。」Benny 拒絕了：「會有太多動物，如果有人踩到我的腳怎麼辦？」但兔子沒有放棄，她做了 Benny 最愛的蜂蜜蛋糕，說：「來嘛，只待一個小時就好。」在慶典上，Benny 又跳又唱，甚至把蜂蜜蛋糕分給一隻小狐狸。沒有人踩到他的腳。事實上，那是他這輩子最棒的一個晚上。「我擔心的事大部分都不會發生。」他說。

passages.title: 料理鼠王的夢想
passages.text: Remy is a little rat, but he has a big dream: he wants to {1} in a famous restaurant in Paris. Most people think rats are dirty. In {2}, Remy washes his hands more than anyone. One night, he sneaked into the kitchen and made a pot of soup. The next day, a food critic tasted it. "This is the best soup in Paris!" he said. Everyone in the kitchen was {3}. But when they found out a rat made it, the chef wanted to throw him out. Remy's friend Linguini stood up. "This rat is the best cook in this {4}!" he said. From that day on, Remy and Linguini {5} the kitchen, and the restaurant became popular again.

blanks.why: cook「做菜、當廚師」：他想在巴黎有名的餐廳做菜。worry、surprise、hurt in a restaurant 都不通。
in fact「事實上」：大家以為老鼠很髒，事實上 Remy 比誰都愛洗手。其他選項都不是片語。
be surprised「感到驚訝」：大家聽到評論家的稱讚都很驚訝。were cooked、were shared、were fought 用在人身上都不通。
in this place「在這個地方（這家餐廳）」。in this fact、in this surprise、in this festival 都不通。
share the kitchen「共用廚房」。worried、fought、surprised the kitchen 都不通。

passages.zh: 小米是一隻小老鼠，但他有個大夢想：他想在巴黎一家有名的餐廳做菜。大部分的人都覺得老鼠很髒，事實上，小米比任何人都還常洗手。有一天晚上，他偷偷溜進廚房煮了一鍋湯。隔天，一位美食評論家嚐了這道湯，說：「這是全巴黎最好喝的湯！」廚房裡的每個人都很驚訝。但當他們發現湯是老鼠煮的，主廚就想把他趕出去。小米的朋友 Linguini 站出來說：「這隻老鼠是這裡最厲害的廚師！」從那天起，小米和 Linguini 一起共用廚房，餐廳也再度受到歡迎。

passages.title: 爸爸第一次划龍舟
passages.text: The Dragon Boat {1} is my favorite holiday. Every year, my town holds a boat race on the river. This year, my dad's company had a team. One week before the race, Mr. Lin hurt his back. "You can take my {2}," he told Dad. Dad was {3} because he had never rowed a boat before. The team practiced every evening for a week. On the day of the race, Mom {4} rice dumplings for the whole team. Dad's team did not win, but they came in third. After the race, everyone sat by the river and {5} the rice dumplings. Dad said it was the best holiday ever.

blanks.why: Dragon Boat Festival「端午節」。Dragon Boat Market、Fact、Worry 都不是節日名稱。
take one's place「代替某人」：你可以代替我上場。take my fact、surprise、market 都不通。
be worried「擔心」：爸爸沒划過船，所以很擔心。was cooked、was shared、was fought 用在人身上都不通。
cook rice dumplings「煮粽子」。fought、worried、hurt rice dumplings 都不通。
share + 食物「分著吃」：大家在河邊一起分著吃粽子。fought、worried、hurt the rice dumplings 都不通。

passages.zh: 端午節是我最喜歡的節日。每年我們鎮上都會在河上舉辦龍舟比賽。今年，爸爸的公司也組了一隊。比賽前一週，林叔叔傷到了背。「你可以代替我上場。」他對爸爸說。爸爸很擔心，因為他從來沒有划過船。隊員們每天傍晚練習，練了一個星期。比賽當天，媽媽煮了粽子給全隊吃。爸爸的隊伍雖然沒有贏，但得了第三名。比賽結束後，大家坐在河邊一起分著吃粽子。爸爸說這是他過過最棒的節日。

passages.title: 動物冷知識
passages.text: Do you know any fun {1} about animals? Here are three. First, cows have best friends. When they stay {2} to their best friends, they feel calm. Second, sea otters hold hands when they sleep, so they will not drift away from each other. They also {3} food with their babies. Third, elephants are afraid of bees. When they hear bees, they run away. It may be a {4} to you, but even the biggest animals have fears. The more you learn about animals, the more you will {5} about them.

blanks.why: fun facts「有趣的小知識」。fun places、markets、festivals about animals 都不通。
next to「在…旁邊」：和最好的朋友待在一起時會覺得平靜。last to、same to、every to 都不是正確用法。
share + 物 + with + 人「和…分享」：海獺會和寶寶分享食物。fight、worry、cook food with their babies 都不通。
It may be a surprise to you「你可能會很驚訝」。a place、a market、a festival to you 都不通。
care about …「關心、在乎」。cook、sell、park about 都不通。

passages.zh: 你知道哪些有趣的動物小知識嗎？這裡有三個。第一，乳牛有最好的朋友，當牠們待在好朋友身邊時，會覺得很平靜。第二，海獺睡覺時會手牽手，這樣才不會彼此漂散。牠們也會和寶寶分享食物。第三，大象怕蜜蜂，一聽到蜜蜂的聲音就會逃跑。你可能會很驚訝，但就連最大的動物也有害怕的東西。你對動物了解得愈多，就會愈關心牠們。

passages.title: 野餐遇到螞蟻
passages.text: Last Sunday, my family went on a picnic in the park. Mom made sandwiches and {1} some fried chicken. We found a nice {2} under a big tree and put down our blanket. But soon, we had a problem: ants! A {3} of ants came out of the grass. They wanted to {4} our lunch! My little brother screamed. Dad laughed and said, "Let's just move." So we took our food to a sunny spot {5} to the lake. The ants did not follow us, and we had a wonderful lunch.

blanks.why: cook fried chicken「煮（炸）雞」。fought、worried、hurt some fried chicken 都不通。
find a nice place「找到一個好地方」。a nice fact、surprise、festival under a tree 都不通。
a lot of ants「很多螞蟻」。a few 後面不加 of；a chance of、a park of ants 都不通。
share our lunch「分享（搶吃）我們的午餐」，這裡用幽默的說法。fight、worry、cook 我們的午餐都不合理。
next to the lake「在湖旁邊」。last to、same to、every to 都不是正確用法。

passages.zh: 上星期天，我們全家去公園野餐。媽媽做了三明治，還煮了一些炸雞。我們在一棵大樹下找到一個好地方，鋪好野餐墊。但很快就出現一個問題：螞蟻！很多螞蟻從草地裡跑出來，牠們想來分享我們的午餐！弟弟尖叫起來。爸爸笑著說：「我們換個地方就好。」於是我們把食物拿到湖邊一個有陽光的地方。螞蟻沒有跟過來，我們吃了一頓很棒的午餐。

passages.title: 太辣的咖哩
passages.text: My sister Jenny wanted to {1} our parents on their anniversary. She decided to {2} curry for dinner. She found a recipe online, but she put in too much curry powder. When she tasted it, her mouth was on fire! She did not know what to do. "Don't {3}," I said. I remembered that milk can make curry less spicy. We added some, and it tasted much better. When our parents came home, the whole {4} smelled wonderful. They loved the curry, and Dad even had three bowls. {5} year, Jenny says she wants to make a cake.

blanks.why: surprise + 人「給某人驚喜」。sell、park、stay our parents 都不通。
cook curry「煮咖哩」。fight、worry、place curry 都不通。
Don't worry.「別擔心」，後面我想出了解決的辦法。place、sell、park 後面需要受詞，放在這裡不通。
the whole place「整個地方（整間屋子）」都很香。the whole fact、market、festival 都不通。
next year「明年」，配合後面「想要做蛋糕」。Last year 是過去，和 wants to 不搭；Same year、Popular year 都不通。

passages.zh: 我姊姊 Jenny 想在爸媽的結婚紀念日給他們一個驚喜，她決定煮咖哩當晚餐。她在網路上找到食譜，卻放了太多咖哩粉。她一嚐，嘴巴像著火一樣！她不知道該怎麼辦。「別擔心。」我說。我想起牛奶可以讓咖哩沒那麼辣。我們加了一些牛奶，味道好多了。爸媽回到家時，整間屋子香噴噴的。他們很喜歡這道咖哩，爸爸還吃了三碗。Jenny 說，明年她想做蛋糕。

passages.title: 捷運站的外國人
passages.text: Last week, I saw a foreign woman at the MRT station. She looked {1} and was holding a map. I wanted to help, but I was shy. Then I thought, "This is my {2} to use my English!" "Excuse me, can I help you?" I asked. She smiled. "I want to go to the night {3} in Shilin." I told her to take the red line. "Get off at Jiantan. It is the {4} stop after Yuanshan." She thanked me and gave me a little gift from her country: a chocolate bar. It was a nice {5}. That day, I felt proud of my English.

blanks.why: look worried「看起來很擔心」。cooked、shared、fought 都不能形容她的樣子。
a chance to + 原形動詞「做…的機會」：這是我用英文的機會！example 前要用 an；a park、a care 都不通。
night market「夜市」：她想去士林夜市。night fact、surprise、place 都不是正確說法。
the next stop「下一站」：劍潭是圓山的下一站。same、every、few 都不能這樣用。
a nice surprise「令人開心的驚喜」：意外收到巧克力。a nice fact、market、place 都不能形容收到的禮物。

passages.zh: 上星期，我在捷運站看到一位外國女士，她看起來很擔心，手上拿著地圖。我想幫忙，但很害羞。接著我想：「這是我用英文的機會！」「不好意思，需要幫忙嗎？」我問。她笑了：「我想去士林夜市。」我告訴她搭紅線：「在劍潭下車，就是圓山的下一站。」她向我道謝，還送我一個她國家的小禮物：一條巧克力。這真是個驚喜。那天，我為自己的英文感到很驕傲。

passages.title: 貓狗大戰
passages.text: Our cat, Mimi, and our dog, Bobo, used to {1} every day. Mimi did not want to {2} her bed with Bobo, and Bobo always ate Mimi's food. My mom was {3} that they would hurt each other. Then one cold winter night, the power went out. The house was dark and very cold. In the morning, we found a big {4}: Mimi and Bobo were sleeping together in the same bed! From that day on, they became best friends. Now Bobo sleeps {5} to Mimi every night, and they even eat from the same bowl.

blanks.why: used to fight「以前常打架」。貓狗不會做菜（cook），surprise、place 後面需要受詞，都不通。
share + 物 + with + 人「和…共用」：Mimi 不想和 Bobo 共用床。fight、cook、worry her bed 都不通。
be worried that …「擔心…」。was cooked、was shared、was fought 用在人身上都不通。
find a big surprise「發現一個大驚喜」，後面說貓狗睡在一起。a big fact、market、festival 都不通。
next to「在…旁邊」。last to、same to、every to 都不是正確用法。

passages.zh: 我們家的貓 Mimi 和狗 Bobo 以前每天都打架。Mimi 不想跟 Bobo 共用床，Bobo 又老是偷吃 Mimi 的食物。媽媽很擔心牠們會傷到彼此。後來在一個寒冷的冬夜，家裡停電了，屋子又黑又冷。早上，我們發現一個大驚喜：Mimi 和 Bobo 睡在同一張床上！從那天起，牠們變成了好朋友。現在 Bobo 每天晚上都睡在 Mimi 旁邊，牠們甚至會用同一個碗吃東西。

passages.title: 一起撐傘回家
passages.text: It started to rain hard after school. I did not have an umbrella, so I stood at the school gate and {1} about how to get home. Then Yuna, the girl who sits {2} to me in class, came over. We did not talk much before. "Do you want to {3} my umbrella?" she asked. On the way home, we talked about our favorite anime. We found out that we liked the same singer, too. It was a nice {4}. The rain did not stop until we got to my {5}. Now we walk home together every day, rain or shine. I am glad it rained that day.

blanks.why: worry about …「擔心…」：我擔心要怎麼回家。cooked、fought、shared about 都不通。
sit next to + 人「坐在某人旁邊」。last to、same to、every to 都不是正確用法。
share an umbrella「共撐一把傘」。fight、cook、place my umbrella 都不通。
a nice surprise「令人開心的驚喜」：發現喜歡同一位歌手。a nice market、place、worry 都不通。
my place「我家」，place 可以指某人住的地方。my fact、my surprise、my festival 都不通。

passages.zh: 放學後開始下起大雨。我沒帶傘，只好站在校門口，擔心該怎麼回家。這時，坐在我旁邊的 Yuna 走了過來。我們以前沒說過幾句話。「你要不要跟我一起撐傘？」她問。回家路上，我們聊起最喜歡的動漫，還發現我們喜歡同一位歌手，真是個驚喜。雨一直下到我們走到我家才停。現在不論晴雨，我們每天都一起走路回家。我很高興那天下了雨。

passages.title: 第一次逛漫畫博覽會
passages.text: Every summer, there is a big comic {1} in Taipei. Thousands of fans come to buy comics and meet their favorite artists. This year, my friend Ivy and I went there for the first time. The {2} was so crowded that we could hardly move. Ivy wanted to meet a famous artist, so we waited in line for two hours. When it was finally our turn, the artist drew a little picture for Ivy. She was so {3} that she could not say a word. On the train home, we {4} the comics we bought and read them together. We are already planning to go again {5} year.

blanks.why: comic festival「漫畫節、漫畫博覽會」。comic fact、comic surprise、comic worry 都不通。
The place was crowded「那個地方很擁擠」。The fact、surprise、worry was crowded 都不通。
be surprised「驚訝」：她驚訝得說不出話。cooked、shared、fought 用在人身上都不通。
share + 物「分享」：我們交換看買到的漫畫。fought、cooked、worried the comics 都不通。
next year「明年」，配合 are planning to go again。last year 是過去，same year、few year 都不通。

passages.zh: 每年夏天，台北都會舉辦盛大的漫畫博覽會。成千上萬的粉絲來這裡買漫畫、見自己喜歡的畫家。今年，我和朋友 Ivy 第一次去。那裡擠到我們幾乎動不了。Ivy 想見一位有名的畫家，所以我們排了兩個小時的隊。終於輪到我們時，那位畫家為 Ivy 畫了一張小圖。她驚訝得說不出話來。回家的火車上，我們交換看買到的漫畫。我們已經在計畫明年再去了。

passages.title: 功夫熊貓包餃子
passages.text: Po the panda loves food more than anything. One day, his dad, Mr. Ping, said, "Today, I will teach you how to {1} dumplings." Po was excited, but he was not good at it. He used too much water, and the dumplings broke. "Don't {2}," his dad said. "Even kung fu masters make mistakes." Po tried again and again. At last, he made a perfect plate of dumplings. "Let's {3} them with the Furious Five!" he said. His friends came, and they all sat {4} to the window and ate together. Then Po gave his last dumpling to Tigress. It was a big {5} to everyone, because Po never gives away food!

blanks.why: cook dumplings「煮餃子」。worry、fight、surprise dumplings 都不通。
Don't worry.「別擔心」，後面安慰他「大師也會犯錯」。place、sell、park 需要受詞，放在這裡不通。
share + 物 + with + 人「和…分享」。fight、worry、surprise them with the Furious Five 都不通。
sit next to the window「坐在窗邊」。last to、same to、every to 都不是正確用法。
a big surprise to everyone「讓大家很驚訝的事」，因為阿波從不把食物送人。a big fact、market、festival 都不通。

passages.zh: 熊貓阿波最愛的就是食物。有一天，他的爸爸平先生說：「今天我來教你煮餃子。」阿波很興奮，但他不太會煮。他水放太多，餃子都破了。「別擔心，」爸爸說，「連功夫大師也會犯錯。」阿波一次又一次地嘗試，終於煮出一盤完美的餃子。「我們跟蓋世五俠一起分享吧！」他說。朋友們來了，大家坐在窗邊一起吃。接著阿波把最後一顆餃子讓給了悍嬌虎。這讓大家都很驚訝，因為阿波從來不會把食物讓給別人！

passages.title: 圖書館最好的座位
passages.text: In our school library, there is one perfect {1} to study: the seat by the big window. Every student wants it, so people often {2} over it. Last month, the librarian made a new rule. "If you want the seat, write your name on the list. You can only use it for one hour. After that, you must move to the table {3} to the door." At first, some students were not happy. But now everyone gets a turn, and nobody {4} about the seat anymore. The librarian said, "A good seat is like a good book. It is better when you {5} it."

blanks.why: a perfect place to study「讀書的完美地點」。a perfect fact、surprise、worry to study 都不通。
fight over …「為了…爭搶」。cook over、share over、surprise over it 都不通。
next to the door「門旁邊」。last to、same to、every to 都不是正確用法。
worry about …「擔心」，nobody 用第三人稱單數 worries。cooks、shares、places about 都不通。
share + 物「分享」：好座位和好書一樣，分享才更好。fight、cook、worry it 都不通。

passages.zh: 我們學校的圖書館裡，有一個讀書的完美地點：大窗戶旁邊的座位。每個學生都想坐，所以大家常常為了它搶來搶去。上個月，圖書館員訂了一條新規定：「想坐那個位子，就把名字寫在名單上。每人只能用一個小時，時間到了就要移到門旁邊的桌子。」一開始，有些同學不太高興。但現在每個人都輪得到，再也沒有人為那個位子煩惱了。圖書館員說：「好座位就像好書一樣，分享出去會更好。」

passages.title: 聖誕節交換禮物
passages.text: Our class had a gift exchange before Christmas. Everyone bought a small gift and put it in a big box. Then we took turns picking one. Nobody knew what they would get, so every gift was a {1}. I got a pair of socks with cats on them. My friend Andy got a cookbook. "I can't even {2} an egg!" he said. Everyone laughed. Andy was {3} at first, but he tried one recipe that night. The {4} day, he brought a big box of fried rice to school. He {5} it with everyone in class. "This is the best gift ever," he said.

blanks.why: be a surprise「是個驚喜」：沒人知道會拿到什麼，所以每份禮物都是驚喜。a fact、a market、a festival 都不通。
cook an egg「煮（煎）一顆蛋」，配合拿到食譜書。worry、fight、surprise an egg 都不通。
be worried「擔心」。was cooked、was shared、was fought 用在人身上都不通。
the next day「隔天」。the few day、the every day、the enough day 都不是正確說法。
share + 物 + with + 人「和…分享」。fought、worried、placed it with everyone 都不通。

passages.zh: 聖誕節前，我們班舉辦了交換禮物。每個人買一份小禮物放進一個大箱子，然後輪流抽一份。沒有人知道自己會拿到什麼，所以每份禮物都是驚喜。我拿到一雙有貓咪圖案的襪子。我的朋友 Andy 拿到一本食譜書。「我連一顆蛋都不會煎！」他說。大家都笑了。Andy 一開始很擔心，但那天晚上他試做了一道菜。隔天，他帶了一大盒炒飯到學校，分給全班同學吃。「這是我收過最棒的禮物。」他說。

passages.title: 台南美食之旅
passages.text: Last summer, my family took a trip to Tainan. It is a {1} famous for its delicious food. On the first night, we went to a night {2} and tried shrimp rolls and beef soup. The beef soup was amazing. The cook {3} raw beef in a bowl and poured hot soup on it. "Is it safe to eat?" I asked. "Don't {4}," Dad said. "The hot soup {5} the meat in a few seconds." I tried it, and it was the best beef soup I have ever had. Now I want to go back to Tainan every year.

blanks.why: a place famous for …「以…出名的地方」。a fact、a surprise、a worry famous for food 都不通。
night market「夜市」。night fact、night surprise、night worry 都不是正確說法。
place + 物 + in + 地方「把…放在…」：廚師把生牛肉放進碗裡。fought、worried、shared raw beef in a bowl 都不通。
Don't worry.「別擔心」，回答「安全嗎？」。place、sell、park 需要受詞，放在這裡不通。
cook the meat「把肉煮熟」，主詞 the hot soup 用 cooks。fights、worries、shares the meat 都不通。

passages.zh: 去年夏天，我們全家去台南旅行。台南是以美食出名的地方。第一天晚上，我們去夜市吃了蝦捲和牛肉湯。牛肉湯好吃極了！老闆把生牛肉放進碗裡，再把熱湯淋上去。「這樣吃安全嗎？」我問。「別擔心，」爸爸說，「熱湯幾秒鐘就能把肉燙熟。」我吃了一口，那是我喝過最好喝的牛肉湯。現在我每年都想回台南。

passages.title: 傑克與魔豆
passages.text: Jack and his mother were very poor. One day, his mother said, "Take our cow to the {1} and sell it." On the way, Jack met an old man. "I will give you five magic beans for your cow," the man said. Jack said yes. When he got home, his mother was angry and threw the beans out of the window. In the morning, Jack got a big {2}: a huge beanstalk outside his window! He climbed it and found a giant's castle at the top. He took a golden hen and ran down. Then he cut the beanstalk, so he did not need to {3} the giant. The hen laid a golden egg every day. "Don't {4}, Mother," Jack said. "We will never be poor again." He even {5} the eggs with poor people in his town.

blanks.why: take + 物 + to the market「帶…去市場」，後面要把牛賣掉。to the fact、surprise、worry 都不通。
get a big surprise「大吃一驚」：窗外長出巨大的豆莖。a big fact、market、festival 都不通。
fight the giant「和巨人打鬥」：砍斷豆莖，就不用和巨人打了。cook、share、place the giant 都不通。
Don't worry.「別擔心」，後面說「再也不會窮了」。place、sell、park 需要受詞，這裡不通。
share + 物 + with + 人「分給…」：他把金蛋分給鎮上的窮人。fought、worried、placed the eggs with people 都不通。

passages.zh: 傑克和媽媽非常貧窮。有一天，媽媽說：「把我們的牛牽到市場去賣。」路上，傑克遇到一位老人。「我用五顆魔豆換你的牛。」老人說。傑克答應了。回到家，媽媽很生氣，把豆子丟出窗外。隔天早上，傑克大吃一驚：窗外長出一棵巨大的豆莖！他爬上去，在頂端發現一座巨人的城堡。他拿走一隻金母雞，趕快爬下來，然後砍斷豆莖，這樣就不必和巨人打鬥了。母雞每天都會下一顆金蛋。「別擔心，媽媽，」傑克說，「我們再也不會窮了。」他甚至把金蛋分給鎮上的窮人。

passages.title: 第一次上台演講
passages.text: Next week, I have to give an English speech in front of the whole school. I am very {1}. My teacher gave me some advice. "Choose a topic you love. Then it will be easy to {2} your ideas." So I decided to talk about my favorite {3} in Taiwan: Kenting. I found many interesting {4} about its beaches and animals online, and I practiced in front of the mirror every night. On the day of the speech, my hands were shaking. But when I started talking, I forgot about my fear. Everyone clapped at the end. The {5} day, my teacher asked me to join the speech contest.

blanks.why: be worried「擔心」：要在全校面前演講，我很擔心。cooked、shared、fought 用在人身上都不通。
share one's ideas「分享想法」。fight、cook、place your ideas 都不通。
my favorite place in Taiwan「我在台灣最喜歡的地方」，後面說墾丁。fact、surprise、worry 都不是地方。
interesting facts about …「關於…的有趣資料」。places、markets、festivals about its beaches 都不通。
the next day「隔天」。the few day、the every day、the enough day 都不是正確說法。

passages.zh: 下星期，我要在全校面前用英文演講，我非常擔心。老師給了我一些建議：「選一個你喜歡的主題，這樣分享想法就會很容易。」所以我決定介紹我在台灣最喜歡的地方：墾丁。我在網路上找到很多關於當地海灘和動物的有趣資料，每天晚上都對著鏡子練習。演講那天，我的手一直發抖，但一開始講，我就忘了害怕。結束時，大家都為我鼓掌。隔天，老師就邀請我參加演講比賽。

passages.title: 國際文化節
passages.text: Our school held an International Culture {1} last Friday. Students from different countries {2} food from home. My friend Ana from Brazil made cheese bread, and Kenji from Japan brought sushi. Each student had a table, and we walked from one table to the {3}. I learned a lot of interesting {4} about other countries. For example, in Brazil, people often {5} a big lunch with their family on Sundays. At the end of the day, I was very full and very happy.

blanks.why: Culture Festival「文化節」：學校舉辦國際文化節。Culture Fact、Culture Worry、Culture Surprise 都不通。
cook food「做菜」：學生做了家鄉的食物。fought、worried、placed food from home 都不通。
from one … to the next「從一個到下一個」。to the few、to the every、to the enough 都不通。
learn facts about …「學到關於…的知識」。places、markets、worries about other countries 都不通。
share a lunch with family「和家人共享午餐」。fight、worry、place a big lunch 都不通。

passages.zh: 上星期五，我們學校舉辦了國際文化節。來自不同國家的學生做了家鄉的食物。我的朋友 Ana 來自巴西，她做了起司麵包；來自日本的 Kenji 帶了壽司。每個學生都有一張桌子，我們從一桌逛到下一桌。我學到了很多關於其他國家的有趣知識。例如在巴西，人們星期天常常和家人一起享用豐盛的午餐。一天下來，我吃得好飽，也好開心。

passages.title: 吵架之後
passages.text: Last Friday, my best friend Jay and I had a big {1} about a basketball game. He said I cheated, and I said he was a bad loser. We did not talk all weekend. On Monday, I {2} that we would never be friends again. At lunch, I saw him sitting alone. I walked over and sat {3} to him. "I am sorry," I said. Jay looked {4}. Then he smiled. "Me too." He {5} his cookies with me, and we were friends again. Now we know that one game is not more important than a friend.

blanks.why: have a fight「吵架」，fight 在這裡是名詞。a big fact、place、market about a game 都不通。
worry that + 句子「擔心…」。cooked、shared、placed that 都不通。
sit next to + 人「坐在某人旁邊」。last to、same to、every to 都不是正確用法。
look surprised「看起來很驚訝」，沒想到我會道歉。cooked、shared、fought 都不能形容表情。
share + 物 + with + 人「和…分享」。fought、worried、placed his cookies with me 都不通。

passages.zh: 上星期五，我和最好的朋友 Jay 為了一場籃球賽大吵一架。他說我作弊，我說他輸不起。整個週末我們都沒說話。星期一，我擔心我們再也當不成朋友了。午餐時，我看到他一個人坐著。我走過去坐在他旁邊，說：「對不起。」Jay 看起來很驚訝，接著笑了：「我也是。」他把餅乾分給我吃，我們又和好了。現在我們知道，一場比賽沒有比朋友更重要。

passages.title: 福隆沙雕比賽
passages.text: Every summer, there is a sandcastle {1} at Fulong Beach. This year, my cousins and I joined the contest. We had two hours to build. First, we chose a good {2} with wet sand. My cousin Max wanted to build a tower, but I wanted to build a dragon. We started to {3} about it. Then my aunt said, "Why not build both? A dragon {4} to a tower!" We worked together, and it looked great. But just before the end, a big wave came and broke the tower. We were sad, but the judges gave us a special prize for teamwork. It was a big {5}.

blanks.why: sandcastle festival「沙雕節」。sandcastle fact、worry、surprise 都不通。
choose a good place「選一個好地點」。a good fact、worry、surprise with wet sand 都不通。
fight about …「為了…爭吵」。cook、share、place about it 都不通。
next to「在…旁邊」：一條龍在一座塔旁邊。last to、same to、every to 都不是正確用法。
a big surprise「一個大驚喜」：沒想到會得到特別獎。a big fact、worry、place 都不能形容得獎這件事。

passages.zh: 每年夏天，福隆海灘都會舉辦沙雕節。今年，我和表哥表妹們參加了比賽，我們有兩個小時可以堆。首先，我們選了一個沙子濕濕的好地點。表哥 Max 想堆一座塔，我卻想堆一條龍，我們為此吵了起來。這時阿姨說：「為什麼不兩個都堆？一條龍在一座塔旁邊！」我們一起合作，作品看起來很棒。但就在快結束時，一個大浪打來，把塔沖壞了。我們很難過，但評審頒給我們一個團隊合作特別獎。真是個大驚喜。

passages.title: 會做菜的機器人
passages.text: My family bought a robot that can {1} any dish. Its name is Chef Bot. On the first night, it made beef noodles, and they were perfect! But on the second night, there was a problem. Chef Bot did not know the {2} that my sister cannot eat peanuts. It put peanuts in the salad. Luckily, Mom saw it before dinner. She was very {3}. So Dad added a new rule to Chef Bot's program: "No peanuts." The {4} day, Chef Bot made peanut-free cookies for everyone. My sister was so happy that she {5} them with her classmates.

blanks.why: cook any dish「做任何一道菜」。worry、fight、surprise any dish 都不通。
the fact that + 句子「…這個事實」：它不知道妹妹不能吃花生。the place、market、festival that 都不通。
be worried「擔心」。was cooked、was shared、was fought 用在人身上都不通。
the next day「隔天」。the few day、the every day、the enough day 都不是正確說法。
share + 物 + with + 人「和…分享」。fought、worried、placed them with her classmates 都不通。

passages.zh: 我們家買了一台什麼菜都會做的機器人，名字叫「主廚機器人」。第一天晚上，它做了牛肉麵，味道完美！但第二天晚上出了問題：它不知道妹妹不能吃花生，竟然在沙拉裡放了花生。幸好媽媽在晚餐前發現了，她非常擔心。於是爸爸在它的程式裡加了一條新規則：「不准用花生。」隔天，主廚機器人做了不含花生的餅乾給大家。妹妹開心得把餅乾分給了班上同學。

passages.title: 吃不完的年夜飯
passages.text: On Lunar New Year's Eve, my grandma always {1} too much food. This year, there were twenty dishes on the table, but only eight people. "Grandma, we cannot eat all this!" I said. "Don't {2}," she said with a smile. "I have a plan." The next morning, she put the leftovers in boxes. Then she took us to the old people's home {3} to our building. We {4} the food with the old people there. They were so happy, and one old man even sang a song for us. For me, that was the best part of the {5}.

blanks.why: cook too much food「煮太多菜」。fights、worries、surprises too much food 都不通。
Don't worry.「別擔心」，後面說「我有個計畫」。place、sell、park 需要受詞，這裡不通。
next to「在…旁邊」：我們大樓旁邊的養老院。last to、same to、every to 都不是正確用法。
share + 物 + with + 人「和…分享」。fought、worried、placed the food with the old people 都不通。
the best part of the festival「這個節日最棒的部分」，指過年。fact、market、worry 都不通。

passages.zh: 每年除夕，奶奶總是煮太多菜。今年桌上有二十道菜，卻只有八個人。「奶奶，我們吃不完啦！」我說。「別擔心，」她笑著說，「我有個計畫。」隔天早上，她把剩菜裝進盒子裡，帶我們去大樓旁邊的養老院，把菜分給那裡的老人家。他們好開心，有一位老爺爺甚至唱了一首歌給我們聽。對我來說，那是過年最棒的部分。

passages.title: 爺爺的藏寶圖
passages.text: When we were cleaning Grandpa's house, my cousin found an old map in a box. There was a big red X on it. "It's a treasure map!" she shouted. Grandpa smiled but did not say anything. We followed the map to a {1} behind the old school. There was a big tree there. We dug under it and found a metal box. Inside, there were old photos, letters, and toys. It was a big {2}. Grandpa came over. "In {3}, I put this box here sixty years ago," he said. "I always {4} that someone would find it before me." He picked up a photo of three boys. "These were my best friends. We {5} everything when we were young."

blanks.why: follow the map to a place「跟著地圖到一個地方」。a fact、surprise、worry behind the school 都不通。
a big surprise「一個大驚喜」：挖到一箱老東西。a big fact、worry、market 都不通。
in fact「事實上」：其實這箱子是爺爺放的。in market、in festival、in example 都不是片語。
worry that + 句子「擔心…」。cooked、shared、fought that 都不通。
share everything「什麼都一起分享」，說明好朋友的感情。worried、surprised、parked everything 都不通。

passages.zh: 我們在打掃爺爺家時，表姊在一個箱子裡發現了一張舊地圖，上面有一個大大的紅色 X。「是藏寶圖！」她大喊。爺爺笑了笑，什麼也沒說。我們跟著地圖走到舊學校後面的一個地方，那裡有一棵大樹。我們在樹下挖，挖出一個金屬盒子，裡面有舊照片、信和玩具。真是個大驚喜！爺爺走了過來。「事實上，這個盒子是我六十年前放在這裡的，」他說，「我一直擔心會有人比我先找到它。」他拿起一張三個男孩的合照：「他們是我最好的朋友。我們小時候什麼都一起分享。」
